card.name: Scattered words in Australian education and farming text
card.fires_on: No single word type; it fires on scattered nouns and adverbs such as Faculty, native, quite and welfare in Australian university, policy or farming web text.

modes.label: University faculty
modes.description: The word Faculty (or its start) in Australian university course listings.

modes.label: Land and policy nouns
modes.description: Words like native, pasture, provision or welfare in text about agriculture or public policy.

card.plain: It reacts to a loose mix of words from Australian university and farming web pages, with no tidy pattern.
